'''Simon Lee''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Vegas DPC]] on 28 April 2001 with [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Ops Build DS2]] and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base Flip mains]], according to Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2247">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-06-the-bull-at-dpc-vegasd2247/ the-bull-at-dpc-vegas], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 6 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-06-the-bull-at-dpc-vegasd2247/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
